firstPlayerRule: Randomly choose a player to be the first player and give them the current player token. That player chooses their character first and takes the first turn.
clarifications: Character selection proceeds clockwise from the first player.
The starting player does not draw Skill Cards during setup; everyone else draws three.
Players take complete turns clockwise; at the end of a turn, the current player token passes to the left.

sources.title: Battlestar Galactica: The Board Game — Rulebook

internalEvidence: Downloaded the base-game rulebook from Fantasy Flight Games' own CDN and extracted text from PDF pages 5, 6, 9 and 11. Setup step 3 'Determine First Player: Randomly choose a player to be the first player, and give him the current player token. This player will choose his character first and take the first turn of the game.' Step 8: the starting player receives no Skill Cards during setup. Page 9: turns start with the first player and proceed clockwise; page 11: the current player token passes to the left. Credits list NBC Universal and SCI FI; this is the base game, BGG 37111, not the Pegasus/Exodus/Daybreak expansion rulebooks.
